summary: Windows Studio Effects applies AI-driven automatic framing, background blur, eye contact correction, portrait lighting, and voice focus during video calls. It is on by default on Copilot+ PCs but can be turned off from camera settings.

steps.path: Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Cameras → Connected cameras → select your camera
Click Edit next to Advanced camera options → toggle off 'Use Windows Studio Effects'

collateral: disabling Studio Effects means no automatic background blur or noise cancellation in video calls
some apps like Teams have their own background blur that will still work independently
whyTheyDidIt: Microsoft wants Copilot+ PC hardware capabilities to be visible to users during every call.

sources.label: MakeUseOf — I disabled all 10 AI features in Windows 11
